A grey downspout pipe enters from the right side, connected via a green flexible hose or adapter to an inlet near the top of the barrel. A horizontal reinforcing rib circles the middle of the barrel. The background shows a blurry concrete or paved surface.

The connection between the rigid grey downspout and the green flexible hose/adapter lacks clear mechanical logic. The geometry seems to melt into each other slightly without a distinct coupling or seal, appearing physically ambiguous.
